facts.en: Paid passenger information assistant at Fictional Silverreed Coach Station from 2020-06 to 2023-12.
facts.zh: 2020-06 至 2023-12 在虚构银苇长途汽车站任有薪乘客信息助理。

facts.en: Transferred to the same station’s paid lost-property desk role from 2024-01 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2024-01 至 2026-08 转至同一车站的有薪失物柜台岗位。

facts.en: Completed a service administration diploma at Fictional Dovewell College in 2020.
facts.zh: 2020 年在虚构鸽井学院完成服务行政文凭课程。

facts.en: Recorded reported find locations, arrival times and visible item descriptions on numbered property forms.
facts.zh: 在编号失物表上记录报告的发现地点、到达时间及可见物品描述。

facts.en: Placed items in labeled storage areas and cross-referenced the form number in a spreadsheet.
facts.zh: 将物品放入贴有标签的存放区域，并在电子表格中交叉记录表单编号。

facts.en: Kept a claimant’s stated description separate from staff-recorded item details.
facts.zh: 将认领人陈述的描述与工作人员记录的物品细节分开。

facts.en: The desk supervisor approved release decisions after the station’s checks; the candidate recorded signed handovers.
facts.zh: 柜台主管在车站检查后批准交还决定；候选人记录已签署交接。

facts.en: Limited access to claimant contact sheets according to the supervisor’s access list.
facts.zh: 依据主管的访问名单限制认领人联系表的访问。

facts.en: Prepared a weekly list of items approaching the station’s stated retention review date.
facts.zh: 每周准备即将到达车站规定保管复核日期的物品清单。

facts.en: The retention-review list did not itself authorize disposal, sale or donation of items.
facts.zh: 保管复核清单本身不授权处置、出售或捐赠物品。

facts.en: Helped reconcile a storage-cupboard register in 2025-11.
facts.zh: 2025-11 协助核对储物柜登记表。

facts.en: The cupboard check covered 73 listed items; 68 were present and 5 had signed release slips not yet entered in the spreadsheet.
facts.zh: 储物柜检查涵盖清单上的 73 件物品；68 件在库，5 件有已签署但尚未录入电子表格的交还单。

facts.en: Personally entered those 5 verified release records after the supervisor matched the slips to the property forms.
facts.zh: 在主管将交还单与失物表匹配后，个人录入这 5 条已核实交还记录。

facts.en: Uses numbered paper forms, spreadsheet filters and a simple location-code list.
facts.zh: 使用编号纸质表单、电子表格筛选及简单位置编码清单。

facts.en: The current desk has not used a dedicated lost-property database during the documented role.
facts.zh: 在记录中的任职期间，当前柜台未使用专用失物数据库。

facts.en: Completed a 2026-03 online demonstration of a fictional property-tracking platform using sample records; no live station deployment followed.
facts.zh: 2026-03 使用示例记录完成虚构失物跟踪平台的在线演示；此后未在车站实际部署。

facts.en: In the earlier information role, explained printed departures and directed accessibility requests to the duty manager.
facts.zh: 在较早的信息岗位中，解释纸质发车信息，并将无障碍需求转交值班经理。

facts.en: Volunteered with Fictional Maplekey Puzzle Club from 2022-02 to 2024-10.
facts.zh: 2022-02 至 2024-10 在虚构枫匙拼图社做志愿者。

facts.en: At that club, logged puzzle-box loans and attached component-count notes supplied by members.
facts.zh: 在该社团记录拼图盒借用，并附上成员提供的组件数量备注。

facts.en: Co-designed 7 noncommercial paper escape-room clue cards with 2 club members in 2023.
facts.zh: 2023 年与 2 名社团成员共同设计 7 张非商业纸质密室解谜线索卡。

facts.en: The candidate drafted the storage-label puzzle; the other members wrote the remaining clues.
facts.zh: 候选人起草储物标签谜题；其余线索由其他成员编写。

facts.en: Enjoys building small mechanical-looking puzzles from cardboard, without motors or electronics.
facts.zh: 爱好用纸板制作外观似机械的小谜题，不使用电机或电子元件。
